_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture for the topic-paper tests (fictional). A later chat about the same community garden plot.

messages.message: Update on my plot 7 at the Maple Street community garden: I paid the forty dollar fee today.
Great, the plot fee is done. Did you get the hose yet?
Not yet. Also I changed my mind: no zucchini, I'll plant tomatoes instead, plus the peppers and lettuce.
Tomatoes instead of zucchini. They need stakes or cages, so add those to the list.
Right, buy four tomato cages. And the garden manager said watering days are Tuesday and Saturday.
Got it: four tomato cages, and watering on Tuesdays and Saturdays.
